# opnsense_openvpn_static_key (Data Source)

Reads an OpenVPN static key by UUID. Although Terraform redacts the sensitive
`key` in normal CLI output, data-source values remain in plan/state. Use
`opnsense_openvpn_generate_key` when the key must be ephemeral.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Static-key UUID.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) Static key material. Sensitive values from data sources remain in Terraform state.
- `mode` (String) Key usage mode.
